name: I am Dhruv Garg
description: My name is Dhruv Garg and I am a B.Tech student passionate about AI and Web Development.
my-description: I am a Computer Science engineering student at SKIT, Jaipur. I specialize in Generative AI, LLM Applications, Prompt Engineering, Machine Learning, and building scalable full-stack applications.
design-info: Building intelligent AI applications using LLMs, RAG pipelines, LangChain, vector databases, and chatbot systems for real-world automation and user interaction.
development-info: Developing predictive models and deep learning solutions using Python, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, and PyTorch for data-driven problem solving.
marketing-info: Performing data cleaning, visualization, and analysis using Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Plotly to extract meaningful business insights.
maintenance-info: Deploying AI/ML applications using Docker, Hugging Face, Streamlit, Git, and cloud platforms for scalable and production-ready solutions.
about-info-1: Hi, I'm Dhruv Garg, a B.Tech student in Computer Science and Engineering at SKIT, Jaipur. I have a strong passion for Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Web Development. I love solving complex problems and exploring the real-world applications of Generative AI.
about-info-2: I consider myself an avid learner and a tech enthusiast. Recently, I built an AI-Powered Fraud Detection system using Llama 3 and a Flask-based Image Editor. I also actively participate in hackathons, like the GIT Hackathon 2024 where I secured a top 10 position.
about-info-3: I am constantly honing my skills in Python, Java, SQL, and various modern web and AI frameworks to build innovative and impactful projects.
about-skills-1: Proficient in Python for backend development, scripting, and machine learning.
about-skills-2: Experienced in building robust APIs using FastAPI and Flask.
about-skills-3: Familiar with modern frontend development using React and Next.js.
about-skills-4: Skilled in integrating AI models and APIs into web applications.
about-skills-5: Knowledgeable in using SQL and Redis for data management.
about-skills-6: Proficient with Git, GitHub, and continuous deployment workflows.
about-skills-7: Strong foundation in data structures and algorithmic problem-solving.
about-skills-8: Experience with Data visualization libraries like Matplotlib and Seaborn.
about-skills-9: Deep interest in Prompt Engineering and fine-tuning Language Models.
services-questions-1: What is a responsive web page?
services-questions-p1: It is that page that is capable of adapting to any device where it is viewed, such as cell phones, tablets, laptops, without losing appearance or usability.
services-questions-2: What is a Domain and a Hosting?
services-questions-p2: Both are essential elements of a website. In short, the domain name is the address of the web page, while the hosting provides the space and resources necessary to launch the website.
services-questions-p3: Regular maintenance of your website allows you to attract and retain customers with new information, new products and services, in addition to helping you maintain or improve your ranking in Google.
